item.title: Feature: The Seven-Year Silence: How Ocarina Of Time Held My Grief At Seven Years Old

description.p: A safe space to process the unthinkable.The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is frequently crowned the greatest game ever made, celebrated for its dungeons, its music, and a critical legacy that stands as the highest-reviewed title in gaming history. For those of us who were there at the time, it was for gaming what the sequence in The Wizard of Oz is when the world around Dorothy turns to colour: pure magic and wonder.But for those of us who look to art to make sense of the unthinkable, it was something much more fragile and vital. In the summer of my seventh year my world collapsed, and that same winter a Nintendo 64 cartridge became the only safe space I had left to process the loss of my father.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Slim Or Fuller? Atelier Karia "Body Shape Change Feature" Confirmed

description.p: "What kind of Karia would you like to adventure with?".The Koei Tecmo fantasy alchemy RPG Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories is making its way to the Switch 2 early next year. In an update from Gust this week, it confirmed a "body shape change feature" is officially on the way.In a post on the game's website, the developer revealed it has decided to implement this feature based on recent community survey results and feedback. Karia's body shape "will change depending on how much she eats during snacks". Players will also be able to turn the body shape changes "on" and "off" (and lock the shape) based on their preferences.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Call Of Duty On Switch 2 Has Two Different Upscaling Options

description.p: Here's an early explainer on the difference.Our impressions of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign went live yesterday alongside early access for anyone who pre-ordered the game. The full launch comes on Friday 23rd October, but buying now unlocks access to the full campaign before the multiplayer modes.As you may know if you've played the Switch 2 version already, buried in the Graphics settings are two different upscaling options. One is Nvidia's AI-powered DLSS upscaler, and the other is Infinity Ward's in-house anti-aliasing solution, labelled "Filmic SMAA T2X".Read the full article on nintendolife.com
